proposedPhase23.title: Smallest safe Phase 2.3: eliminate duplicate client history enrich when server MC already graded
proposedPhase23.change: In enrichCoachPropSimHits / simPropBatch: when server hitProbability is already a usable MC grade, skip getPlayerHistory (or accept optional thin history slices returned with prop-sim rows). Keep local history fallback only for null/unusable MC.
proposedPhase23.optionalFollowup: Raise default SLATE_SIM_BATCH 2→4 to match inner concurrency (football mix already uses 4) — preserves progressive partials, cuts serial game-span wall. Bench shows ~2× wall reduction 2→4, 0×429, no equation change.
proposedPhase23.expectedImpact: Remove ~23 client player-history RTTs / ~10.6s sum (span extending to ~31s) from scan tail without changing MC equations, markets, thresholds, or final deterministic qualified set inputs.
proposedPhase23.mustPreserve: ESPN mapping, 10k sims, markets/ALTs, thresholds, EV/edge/grade/confidence, correlation/diversity, no fabricated history, local fallback when MC null
proposedPhase23.notInScope: Early exit at first 5 GL — remaining work alters final ticket
